summary: Lower a proven builtin Array-of-pairs iterable through a helper that preserves Map constructor pair extraction and SameValueZero keys.

semantics.iteration: Array iterator order, including holes as undefined
semantics.duplicate_keys: later values replace without moving original key position

caveats: A hole in the outer array is iterated as undefined and therefore causes TypeError because a Map entry must be an object.
Pair access may invoke getters; helper must preserve left-to-right property access.

tests.name: sparse outer array throws
tests.input: const a=[]; a.length=1; try { new Map(a); } catch(e) { console.log(e.name); }
